title.narrative: NPLs of credit lines used by PFIs with Project funds versus the PFIâ€™s total NPLs for the relevant sector

comment.narrative:
This indicator compares the NPL weighted average ratio of credit lines used by PFIs to provide subloans to eligible MSMEs with Project funds versus the NPLs of CFN's first tier lending to MSMEs. NPLs will be considered those subloans with more than 90 days of arrears.
Note: the definition of this indicator was changed when the AF was processed, therefore the previous value is nt comparable.
